 Bharti Airtel surges on adding 26.92 lakh subscribers in September
 News By Tags | 
 #BhartiAirtelLtd 
 #TelecomSector 
 #StockMarket 
 Bharti Airtel is currently trading at Rs. 1974.90, up by 57.90 points or 3.02% from its previous closing of Rs. 1917.00 on the BSE.
 The scrip opened at Rs. 1921.85 and has touched a high and low of Rs. 1,978.00 and Rs. 1910.00 respectively. So far 165822 shares were traded on the counter.
 The BSE group 'A' stock of face value Rs. 5 has touched a 52 week high of Rs. 2174.70 on 21-Nov-2025 and a 52 week low of Rs. 1726.05 on 01-Oct-2026.
 Last one week high and low of the scrip stood at Rs. 1,977.90 and Rs. 1,860.40 respectively. The current market cap of the company is Rs. 1225201.00 crore.
 The promoters holding in the company stood at 50.07%, while Institutions and Non-Institutions held 47.19% and 2.75% respectively.
 Bharti Airtel has added 26.92 lakh customers in September 2026. Following this, the company’s total customer base has increased to 49.43 crore with market share of 38.02% in terms of wireless (Mobile) subscribers as on September 30, 2026.
